title: External STEP performance corpus
purpose: Reproduce local STEP conversion, browser interaction and source-size rejection checks without adding third-party CAD bytes to the application.
storage: Download outside the repository. These sources are not shipped in the Preview, extension or portable source archive.
identityPolicy: SHA-256 and exact byte length identify the tested bytes. GitHub URLs use exact commits; the Zenodo URL uses the specific record version. The STEP Tools URL has no immutable version and must still match its recorded SHA-256.
metadataPolicy: Exporter information comes from the downloaded STEP header. A blank STEP author field is not replaced with an inferred individual author. Licenses below record publisher or repository declarations.
